text: Every pull request this week except one knowledge article changes behaviour, and none is breaking. Sales Order Agent got two changes: #13495 moves its auxiliary model calls from GPT-4.1 to GPT-5.6 Ceres and lets its instructions accept the page's default availability period when no delivery date was requested, keeping those system dates out of Requested Delivery Date. #13469 stops the duplicate-contact notification from appearing on outgoing email review pages. Expense Agent got three changes. #13460 quotes and escapes G/L account filters so apostrophes and parentheses no longer break lookups. #13185 fixes itemization rounding and a missing currency code on line items. #13182 adds a View rules link below Enforce management rules in the setup wizard. Several core fixes also landed. #13417 stops posting a return order linked through Applies-to Doc. No. on a credit memo from wrongly updating original sales order line quantities. #13336 fixes Create Reminders failing when every overdue entry is on hold. #12520 makes Reverse Production Entry work when output was posted in a non-base unit of measure. For Switzerland, #13273 puts Address 1 and Address 2 together in the StrtNm node of the SEPA XML when Address 2 holds the building number for QR-Bills. In BCQuality, #253 adds a performance article on AddLoadFields for API pages.

issues: The paragraph says Expense Agent got four changes, but the week has only three Expense Agent pull requests (#13460, #13185, #13182).
The paragraph says Sales Order Agent changed most, but it had two pull requests (#13495, #13469) and Expense Agent had three. Replaced with a neutral count.
